title: Sidebar page
firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Click the extension icon to open the sidebar panel
Edit src/sidebar/index.html and save to watch the panel update
useCases: A sidebar panel that stays open while you browse
Reading and acting on the page beside it

store.summary: Adds a sidebar panel to the browser.

justifications.sidePanel: Renders the extension's main interface in the browser side panel.

versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the sidebar template. Not yet submitted to any store.
